title: Oil Change & Routine Maintenance
heroDescription: Keep your BMW performing at its best with professional oil changes and scheduled maintenance.
intro: Regular oil changes and routine maintenance are essential to keep your BMW running smoothly, efficiently, and reliably. At BTECH BMW SERVICE, we use BMW-approved synthetic oil and high-quality OEM filters to ensure optimal engine performance and long-term protection.
includes: Drain and replace engine oil with BMW-approved synthetic oil
Replace the oil filter with a high-quality OEM filter
Inspect and top off essential under-hood fluids
Check for oil leaks and evaluate overall engine condition
Reset the BMW service interval and maintenance reminder
Perform a thorough multi-point vehicle inspection
scheduleTitle: When to Schedule an Oil Change?
scheduleDescription: Most BMW models typically need an oil change every 5,000 – 7,500 miles (or up to 10,000 miles depending on driving conditions) or as recommended in your vehicle's service schedule. Regular maintenance helps preserve turbocharger health, fuel efficiency, and long-term engine reliability.
ctaSubtitle: Schedule your oil change and routine maintenance with our BMW specialists today.

scheduleTitle: Signs Your BMW Engine Needs Attention
scheduleDescription: If you notice rough idling, misfires, burning oil odors, coolant or oil leaks, knocking noises, or a Check Engine Light, early inspection prevents minor wear from turning into major internal engine damage.
ctaSubtitle: Trust your BMW engine to Sacramento's dedicated BMW specialists.

title: Transmission Service & Repair
heroDescription: Smooth shifting and dependable drivetrain performance for automatic, DCT, and manual BMW transmissions.
intro: Your BMW's transmission is engineered for crisp, responsive power delivery. At BTECH BMW SERVICE, we perform proper fluid and pan-filter services, mechatronic sealing sleeve repairs, and clutch replacements using factory-spec fluids.
includes: Automatic transmission fluid & integrated pan/filter replacement
Mechatronic sleeve, valve body, and pan gasket leak repair
Manual transmission and differential fluid service
Clutch, flywheel, and hydraulic slave/master cylinder repair
Transmission adaptation resets and shift-quality road test
Transfer case & driveshaft flex-disc (guibo) inspection
scheduleTitle: When to Service Your BMW Transmission?
scheduleDescription: Even when labeled 'lifetime fluid,' BMW automatic transmissions benefit greatly from fluid and filter service every 50,000 – 60,000 miles. Schedule an inspection immediately if you experience delayed engagement, harsh shifts, or fluid leaks.
ctaSubtitle: Keep your BMW drivetrain shifting smoothly with expert transmission care.

New BMW brake pad wear sensor installation and iDrive reset

Complete road test to verify quiet, vibration-free braking
scheduleDescription: Schedule brake service whenever your BMW brake warning light illuminates, you hear squealing or grinding, feel steering wheel vibration while braking, or every 2 years for a routine brake fluid flush.
ctaSubtitle: Ensure safe, responsive stopping power—book your BMW brake inspection today.

heroDescription: Restore BMW's signature handling, ride comfort, and steering precision.
intro: Worn control arm bushings, struts, or tie rods quickly rob a BMW of its sharp handling and cause uneven tire wear. Our technicians inspect and replace suspension and steering components to restore tight, factory-fresh road feel.
includes: Thrust arm, control arm, and ball joint replacement
Struts, shock absorbers, and coil spring replacement
Inner & outer tie rod ends and steering rack inspection
Sway bar end links, bushings, and subframe mount checks
Wheel bearing and hub assembly replacement
Power steering pump, reservoir, and hydraulic hose repair
scheduleTitle: Signs of Suspension or Steering Wear
scheduleDescription: Clunking over bumps, steering wheel vibration at highway speeds, wandering on the road, nose-diving under braking, or uneven tire tread wear are key indicators that your BMW suspension needs inspection.
ctaSubtitle: Bring back the Ultimate Driving Machine feel with expert suspension repair.

scheduleDescription: Any time a warning light appears on your dash, your BMW enters limp mode, or you experience intermittent drivability or electrical glitches—or before buying a pre-owned BMW.
ctaSubtitle: Get fast, accurate answers for any warning light or drivability concern.

title: Cooling System Service
heroDescription: Prevent overheating and protect your BMW engine with proactive cooling system care.
intro: BMW cooling systems operate under high heat and pressure, making radiators, expansion tanks, water pumps, and plastic coolant flanges critical maintenance items. We keep your cooling system sealed, pressurized, and running at ideal operating temperature.
includes: Cooling system pressure test and leak detection
Electric & mechanical water pump and thermostat replacement
Radiator, expansion tank, and coolant hose replacement
Coolant flush and vacuum-fill with BMW-approved coolant
Oil cooler and transmission cooler line inspection
Radiator fan and temperature sensor testing
scheduleTitle: When to Service Your BMW Cooling System?
scheduleDescription: We recommend proactive cooling system inspection every 50,000 – 60,000 miles, or immediately if you see low coolant warnings, sweet coolant smells, white steam, or rising temperature gauges.
ctaSubtitle: Protect your engine from costly overheating—schedule cooling system service today.

scheduleDescription: Slow engine cranking, flickering lights, 'Increased Battery Discharge' warnings, malfunctioning accessories, or repeated dead batteries are signs your charging or electrical system needs testing.
ctaSubtitle: Solve frustrating electrical issues accurately with our BMW technicians.

includes: Exhaust manifold, gasket, and flex-pipe leak repair
Oxygen (O2) sensor and exhaust temperature sensor replacement
Catalytic converter and muffler inspection & replacement

scheduleTitle: When to Inspect Your BMW Exhaust?
scheduleDescription: Book an exhaust check if you hear rattling or louder-than-normal exhaust noise, smell exhaust fumes near the cabin, notice reduced fuel economy, or have an emissions-related Check Engine Light.
ctaSubtitle: Keep your BMW clean, quiet, and compliant—schedule your exhaust inspection.
